arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
Transform into a demon and gain:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}
{icon:bullet,1.2} All {c_important}Archfiend{/c} {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} Skill Variants
{icon:bullet,1.2} An {c_important}Ultimate{/c} {c_important}Archfiend{/c} {c_important}Basic{/c} attack that deals {c_number}{payload:IMPACT}{/c} damage and generates {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} Dominance

Cast again while active to cancel.

During {c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} your Maximum Wrath and Dominance are increased by {c_number}[{SF_33}*100|+%|]{/c} and you deal {c_number}[{SF_34}*100|x1%|]{/c} increased damage for each Demon {c_important}Summon{/c} you have active. When you leave {c_important}Metamorphosis{/c}, casting {c_important}Summon{/c} Skills reduces its Cooldown by {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} |4second:seconds;.

{c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} does not replace any Skills and grants {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} while active. Each Skill cast increases your {c_important}Hellfire{/c} damage by {c_number}[{SF_12}*100|2x%|]{/c} but Burns you for {c_number}[{SF_8}*{SF_6}*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_8*SF_6]){/c} over {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} seconds. Each Cast deals {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%|]{/c} increased Burning to you and {c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} ends if you become {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} or cancel early.

{c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill that does not replace any Skills and lasts for {c_number}[{SF_11}|2|]{/c} seconds. {c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} stacks every second and {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skills do not break its {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} while active.
{c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} increases your {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skill damage by {c_number}[{SF_17}*100|x1%|]{/c} for each {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} bonus Maximum Life you have.

{c_important}Metamorphosis{/c} makes you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} but each time you would be {c_important}{u}Incapacitated{/u}{/c} you take {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} Stagger. You recover from {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} Stagger per second but if you reach {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} Stagger you are Stunned for {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} seconds.
